settings.title: Your gym
settings.readOnly: Only an owner can change these details. You can see them, and the team.

details.title: Details
details.intro: What members see in the app, on your screens and on every post. The name and address also place you on the map.
details.aboutHint: A sentence or two, up to 400 characters. Shown on your gym’s page in the app.

logo.label: Your logo
logo.hint: A PNG with a transparent background is best. It appears on your screens, in the app and on every post the Studio makes.
logo.bgHint: Pick the background your logo is made for, so it never sits on the wrong one.

photo.title: Photo
photo.label: Your gym
photo.hint: The big picture on your gym’s page in the app. Landscape, the floor or the front, people in it if you can.

package.title: Package
package.body: What’s switched on, what each package includes, and how to change it.

email.title: Email
email.recapBody: Sessions, athletes, new faces, the top of the board and your events, in one email. Each of the team chooses for themselves.
email.driftBody: A morning email on days when someone goes well past their usual gap between visits. Never more than one a day.
email.driftBodyWho: A morning email on days when someone goes well past their usual gap between visits, with who. Never more than one a day.

team.title: Team
team.introOwner: Give the people who run {{gym}} their own login. They can use their POWR app account, or set one up from the link.
team.introStaff: Everyone who can run {{gym}} in the portal. Ask an owner to add someone.
team.latestLink: Latest link — works once, for 14 days
team.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the team — nothing has changed.
team.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from {{gym}}? They lose access to the portal straight away.

app.title: Your gym in the app
app.whatMembersSee: What a member sees when they tap your pin on Discover
app.notLoading: Your page isn’t loading right now. Try again in a minute.
app.readOnly: Only an owner can change your page. You can see everything here.

items.logoHint: On your pin and your page
items.name: Name & address

upload.notImage: That isn’t an image. Try a JPG or PNG.
upload.tooBig: That image is over {{mb}} MB. Try a smaller one.

cover.body: The big picture at the top of your page. Landscape works best: the floor or the front, with people in it if you can.
cover.studio: It also goes behind the posts the Studio makes for you.

logo.body: On your page, on your pin on the map, on your screens and on every post. A PNG with a see-through background is best.
logo.bgHint: The background your logo is drawn for, so it never sits on the wrong one.

name.body: At the top of your page and under your pin. Moving the pin itself is on us: tap it on the map.

hours.body: Members see “Open now” or “Closed” as it happens, and today’s hours under it.

about.body: A line or two under your name: what it’s like here, who it’s for, what you’re known for.
about.placeholder: Independent strength gym in Hackney. Open 24/7, coached classes every evening, and the best playlist in E8.

pin.title: Your pin
pin.body: Where members find you on the map, and where Get Directions takes them. It should sit on your front door.
pin.wrongPlace: In the wrong place, or on the wrong side of the building? Tell us and we’ll move it. It matters: it’s how members get to you.

home.title: Set as Home Gym
home.body: The button that makes you someone’s gym in POWR.
home.detail: A member who taps it counts as one of yours: on your board, for you in Gym Clash, and in your numbers here. The quickest way to get them to tap it is your join link.

member.addIntro: A trainer, a coach, anyone members should know. They show on your page as you fill this in.
member.editIntro: Changes show on the phone as you type, and reach members when you save.
member.name: Name
member.bioPlaceholder: Former county rugby player. Strength first, and making it stick around a busy week.
member.bookingHint: Gives them a Book Session button. Any booking page, or a WhatsApp link.
member.profileHint: Gives them a View Profile button: their Instagram or their page on your site.
member.showHint: Untick to hide them for now without losing their details.
member.confirmRemove: Take {{name}} off your page in the app?
member.full: That’s {{max}} people already. Take someone off first.

specialties.hint: Up to 6. They show as tags when a member opens their card.

team.body: Trainers, coaches and staff, on your page in the app. Members can book a session straight from someone’s card.
team.notLoading: Your team isn’t loading right now. Try again in a minute.
team.emptyBody: Put your PTs in front of every member who opens your page. Each one gets a card with their photo, what they’re good at and a Book Session button.
